features:
Features

Made with Real Hershey’s Cocoa

Delivers an authentic, rich chocolate flavor that elevates any dessert.

Gluten-Free and Kosher

Suitable for people with gluten sensitivities and those following kosher diets.

Ready-to-Use Convenience

No mixing or preparation needed—simply open, stir, and spread.

Shelf-Stable

Can be stored in the pantry until needed, making it a great staple for spontaneous baking.

Versatile Use

Perfect for cakes, cupcakes, cookies, brownies, and even dipping or layering.

Benefits

Saves Time

Offers a quick and easy frosting option without the hassle of homemade preparation.

Consistent Results

Provides reliable texture and flavor every time, even for beginner bakers.

Rich and Creamy Texture

Smooth enough for frosting but thick enough to hold shape when decorating.

Family Friendly

Easy for kids and adults to use during baking and decorating sessions.

Delicious Taste

Widely loved for its classic chocolate flavor that pairs well with a variety of baked goods.
ingredients: Frosting (sugar, water, palm oil, corn syrup, HERSHEY'S cocoa, cocoa processed with alkali, corn starch, salt, monoglycerides, polysorbate 60, potassium sorbate [preservative], citric acid, sodium stearoyl lactylate, sodium acid pyrophosphate, natural and artificial flavor), Sugar, Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), REESE'S Peanut Butter (peanuts, sugar, monoglycerides, peanut oil, salt, molasses, corn starch), Whole Wheat Flour. Contains 2% or less of: Vegetable Oil (soybean, palm), High Fructose Corn Syrup, Salt, Corn Starch, Molasses, Honey, Baking Soda, Artificial Flavor.
